title: Source citation
description: One entry per cited source. Referenced by baseline and damage_record rows via source_id.

title.description: Name of the report/dataset/portal, e.g. 'BIPAD Portal incident report'.

publisher.description: Issuing body, e.g. 'National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA)'.

url_or_reference.description: URL, or a physical/document reference if not web-accessible (e.g. 'PDF sitrep #14, on file').

retrieved_date.description: Date this source was accessed/retrieved by this project (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD).

access_note.description: Optional note, e.g. 'Publisher page since removed; PDF archived locally.'
